description: M1 fine theta scan for the twist-disorder appendix (production item 3)

magic_angle.note: theta_magic_fine is the parabola vertex over +-0.01 deg; W_min_fine is the direct fine-grid minimum. The dip is V-shaped, so the parabola vertex slightly overshoots the true tip. Fine minimum (1.035) lies within the locked 1.025 +- 0.0125 deg band.

curvature.note: effective curvature: the dip is nearly linear in |dtheta| so d2W/dtheta2 depends on the fit window (range 8862-16918 over +-0.010 to +-0.030 deg). The near-linear slopes below are the more robust local twist-sensitivity.

disorder_window.note: primary window centered on the locked design angle 1.025 deg to match material.json / AT-2 (7.408 / 7.138 meV); secondary window centered on the fine minimum 1.035 deg for the appendix sensitivity discussion.

coarse_check.note: coarse points recomputed independently; they coincide with the fine-grid values to machine precision (deterministic).

shoulder_artifact.note: small local min-max-min wiggle ~0.05 meV amplitude; a 7x7 k-grid discretization feature far from the magic angle, not physical.
